violations.text: The insect control device (light trap) was observed installed above the prep table. Insect control devices shall be installed so that: (1) The devices are not located over a FOOD preparation area; and (2) Dead insects and insect fragments are prevented from being impelled onto or falling on exposed FOOD; clean EQUIPMENT, UTENSILS, and LINENS; and unwrapped SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES. Insect control must be relocated. New Violation. Correct By: 07/15/2026

Single-service items (cups and lids) were observed stored on the floor in the basement and upstairs near the walk-in freezer. Single-service items must be stored at least 6 inches off the ground. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/08/2026
The condensate from the 3-door freezer unit is draining into a container. Condensate drainage and other non-sewage liquids must drain into a drain. New Violation. Correct By: 11/30/2024
